REFLECTION Network Engineer · Project Management Support Engineer
A Journey That Changed How I See Technology

Working as a Network Engineer and Project Management Support Engineer was more than just a professional experience for me, it became a hub of learning, opportunities, and personal growth that changed the way I looked at technology. Every day brought new challenges, platforms, tools, and real-world problems to solve, which kept me excited and motivated to learn.

From working on network infrastructure and troubleshooting to supporting projects, exploring new technologies, and collaborating with different teams, every experience helped me grow both technically and professionally.

Before this journey, I also pursued one of my biggest dreams joining the Indian Army through the SSC Tech Entry and SSB selection process. It was once a dream I truly wanted to turn into reality, but life has a way of taking us down unexpected paths. Maybe that dream will come true in the next life. Dreams do change, and so do we.

Today, I look back at that chapter with pride and gratitude, while continuing to build my journey in networking, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technology. Every experience, whether a dream achieved or a path left behind, has shaped the person and professional I am becoming.
